subject: The secret I wasn't going to share expires tomorrow
preview_text: I set aside one special thing for users who've been here 30 days. It disappears at midnight.
body_paragraphs: Okay, confession time. I did something a little sneaky 30 days ago when you first downloaded Fresh Start. I tagged your account. Not in a creepy way. In a 'this person is serious about healing' way. And I promised myself that if you stuck with it for a month, I'd show you the back door.

It's not in the app store. You can't Google it. I literally built a separate, unlocked version of the premium features and set it aside. The price is 60% less than what new users will pay next week. Why? Because you've done the hard part. You showed up. You tracked your moods, you fought the 3AM spirals, you built that streak. That grit deserves its own reward.

Opening it unlocks everything. The AI therapist stops holding back and becomes your 24/7 strategic partner, dissecting those obsessive thoughts. The guided exercises go deeper, targeting your specific breakup wounds. The emergency mode gets smarter, predicting your spiral triggers before they hit.

This is the only email you'll get about this. The door closes at midnight tomorrow. Tap the button, open the app, and you'll see the offer waiting on your home screen. Don't overthink it. Just tap. P.S. The 600+ users in our community? The ones who healed 40% faster? Every single one of them said yes to this when their 30-day mark came.
